capabilities: Build review queues from next_review frontmatter dates
Schedule adaptive spaced review with again, hard, good, easy feedback
Track review history, heatmaps, and vault health scores in a Review Center
Pause and resume notes on custom schedules
Run AI mastery exams with verification and delayed rechecks
disambiguation: Not a generic note-review or proofreading tool; it schedules spaced recall reviews of notes.
extras: README doubles as release/development documentation and notes security caveats: API keys and exam drafts are stored unencrypted in vault-local data.json and may sync with configuration files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced-repetition review queue driven by note properties, so users lack scheduling, feedback tracking, and review analytics inside the vault.
